# HP FX900 Pro M.2 SSD 

## A New Generation of SSD Speed 

 8-channel Gen 4 x4 controller Up to 7400 MB/s read speed Independent DRAM cache 

 Overview 

 

 

 INDEPENDENT DRAM CACHE BOOSTS PC PERFORMANCE 

 Equipped with DRAM independent cache (Dynamic SLC caching and DRAM cache buffer), FX900 Pro greatly improves 4 K random read and write performance and reduces SSD access delay. It also supports NCQ (Native Command Queuing) and TRIM command for multi-tasking performance with a continuously fast speed. 

 

Specifications

 Interface PCIe Gen 4.0 x 4, NVMe 1.4 

 Form Factor M.2 2280 

 Capacity 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 4 TB 

 Sequential Read Speed (MB/s) 7000 / 7400 / 7400 / 7400 

 Sequential Write Speed (MB/s) 3800 / 6400 / 6700 / 6700 

 Max. Random Read Speed (IOPS) 540K / 1014K /1344K / 1350K 

 Max. Random Write Speed (IOPS) 938K / 1079K / 1122K / 1150K 

 Dimensions 80 × 22 × 3.2 mm 

 Weight ≤ 10 g 

 MTBF ≥ 1,000,000 hours 

 Operating Temperature 0 °C to 70 °C 

 Storage Temperature -40 °C to 85 °C 

 Vibration Resistance 3.1 GRMS (2-500Hz) 

 Shock Resistance 100 G/ 6 ms 

 Certifications CE, FCC, RoHS, cTUVus, KCC, BSMI, VCCI, RCM 

 Warranty / Support 

 5-Year / 300 TBW - 512 GB 5-Year / 600 TBW - 1 TB 5-Year / 1200 TBW - 2TB 5-Year / 2400 TBW - 4TB

Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Designed for high performance and gaming, FX900 Pro uses 8-channel Gen 4 x4 controller, supports NVMe 1.4 technology, and takes the sequential read/ write speeds up to 7000 MB/s and 6700 MB/s. It breaks through the performance bottleneck of previous PCIe generations to upgrade the computing experience for gamers, professionals, and video makers.

...

Equipped with DRAM independent cache, FX900 Pro greatly improves 4K random read and write performance and reduces SSD access delay.

...

With capacity choices of 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB, HP FX900 Pro SSD gives you the space to store your favorite games, design, 4K HD photos, videos and large files. You'll still have room for the next big title.

...

FX900 Pro M.2 SSD is a PCIe 4.0 high-speed SSD, a new generation enabling superior performance. With a high-performance 8-channel Gen 4 x4 controller and advanced NVMe 1.4 protocol, FX900 Pro achieves up to 7400 MB/s read speed-- that's 2.1X faster than PCIe 3.0 SSD and 13.2X faster than SATA SSD. The independent DRAM cache and ultra-low data delay make it ideal for gamers and professionals seeking ultimate experiences.
